delta.comment: Staging-readiness remediation (2026-08-19, P1 Markdown gate). Applied the repository-established scoped suppression `<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line MD025 -->` before the body H1 to resolve the frontmatter-title/body-H1 conflict. Also corrected three lists that were not preceded by a blank line (so did not render as lists) and wrapped `git cat-file -p :<path> | sha256` in a code span, since the bare `<path>` was parsed as inline HTML and vanished on render. Deliberation content is otherwise unchanged; backlogit doctor validates the artifact as pass.
